functions.name: add
functions.description: Accepts one certificate for host:port (the engine's certificate override). Private tabs: always temporary. Resolves with the certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint (AA:BB:...).

functions.name: remove
functions.description: Removes the exceptions for host:port, of normal and private tabs.

functions.name: list
functions.description: The exceptions of normal tabs, as JSON: [{host, port, sha256}].
